AC-IPC-001.command: rg -q revision_chain_incomplete scripts/check_ip_continuity.sh && rg -q revisions contracts/ip.schema.yaml && rg -q affected_assets scripts/check_ip_continuity.sh

AC-IPC-002.command: bash scripts/check_ip_continuity.sh view --ip ip-demo >/dev/null 2>&1 && rg -q resolved_revision scripts/check_ip_continuity.sh
AC-IPC-002.note: 按 IP 视图 + resolved_revision 引用
